author: GamingBolt
description:
Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls already has a lot going for it, whether it's the gameplay or presentation, and it's an easy recommendation for a wide array of fans, even if they're not typically into fighters. Obviously, the overall responsiveness will be a work in progress, but it's a very fun game out of the gate with a pretty well-balanced roster. 

Time will tell how PlayStation capitalizes on it, but if it's serious about the game's long-term health, Tokon could go down in history as a legendary fighter. For now, however, it'll have to settle for being a plucky upstart, which is more than its pedigree should have allowed.
title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
STALKER 2: Heart of Chornobyl is bringing a whole lot of new content to its Cost of Hope expansion, the first part of a planned three-part story that’s looking to bring more depth and substance to The Zone. It does this by introducing regions that have long been visible but inaccessible, while new enemies, factions, weapons, gear, anomalies, artifacts, and a conflict ready to explode are all part of its appeal.

We’re diving into everything you might want to know before you purchase, so join us as we walk you through what’s new in this exciting expansion.
title: STALKER 2 - Cost of Hope DLC: 10 NEW Details You May Not Know

author: GamingBolt
description:
It's been 20 years since the last Onimusha title, and for two entire console generations, the absence of its particular brand of Genma-slaying stood out more and more as time passed. Thankfully, after a long wait, we're finally getting Onimusha: Way of the Sword – a clean slate of sorts in terms of the narrative but one that honors the series' tradition and expands on its combat in exciting new ways.

Launching on September 4th for Xbox Series X/S, PS5, PC, and Nintendo Switch 2, Onimusha: Way of the Sword could round off an excellent year for its developer. Here's everything you should know before you buy.
title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - 15 Things You Need To Know Before You Buy
